title: The Swanee Inn in Hollywood and Slam Stewart
summary: He worked the Swanee Inn on La Brea, where Slam Stewart and Slim Gaillard also played.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So I struggle aroun' about two years, workin' out in Hollywood. I worked for a nightclub called the Swanee Inn. Was on LaBrea. That's when I run into Slam Stewart and his group out there.
Is that when he was workin' with Slim Gaillard?

Slim Gaillard was workin' with him. Him an' Slam Stewart was together. So, I played there for a coupla years, an' I took off, went back to New York, played again the Apollo Theater, back up in Washington again, played some nightclubs up there, then I left an' come back to New York again.
